title: ElectroLab10.easy: Bilingual Electromagnetism Virtual Laboratory Suite (M1–M12)
description:
ElectroLab10.easy archives and serves 62 standalone HTML5 interactive virtual laboratories (31 in Spanish and 31 paired modules in English) spanning Modules M1 through M12 of university-level Electromagnetism: Coulomb's Law, continuous charge distributions, Gauss's Law, electric potential and equipotentials, capacitance, DC circuits and resistivity, Lorentz force, Biot-Savart law, Ampère's law, Faraday's induction, Maxwell's equations & EM waves, and RLC/LC/phasor oscillations.

Release v1.0.0 establishes a permanent, citable precedent baseline under CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (automated verification suite under Apache-2.0) together with an explicit 4-level physical validation roadmap (VALIDATION_MATRIX.md) covering analytical conservation checks, numerical convergence, and 10.Easy Plasma UI harmonization for subsequent minor releases.
